items.title: Large-Scale Tower Monitoring for Major TowerCo – Africa
items.description: Deployed Invendis iSense RMS controllers across a large portfolio of towers in Sub-Saharan Africa, integrating generator monitoring, fuel management, rectifier parameters, and access control into a single unified platform.
items.metricLabel: Reduction in unnecessary site visits through remote diagnostics

items.title: Tower O&A & Field Efficiency Platform – 70,000+ Sites
items.description: Invendis monitors tower operations for Altius India across 70,000+ towers. The solution includes process automation, real-time alarm ticketing, and a mobile field interface — driving significant operational efficiency gains.
items.metricLabel: Towers actively monitored on Invendis RMS Platform

items.title: OMC Power Energy Measurement & Monitoring
items.description: OMC replaces expensive, polluting diesel generators with smart power plants that bill telecom towers on actual kWh consumed. Its 'ABC' distributed-energy model extends clean, reliable power to anchor telecom sites, local businesses, and rural communities via smart mini-grids in Uttar Pradesh.
items.metricLabel: Automated alarm-to-ticket workflow with zero manual intervention

items.title: Billing & Reconciliation for a Major Saudi Arabia Client
items.description: Invendis deployed multichannel AC meters in 2025 for a major telecommunications operator in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, supporting accurate energy billing and reconciliation across its network sites.
items.metricLabel: Continuous hardware supply in energy meters

items.title: Intel-Based Router Development for US Client
items.description: Invendis designed and delivered a custom Intel-based industrial router for a US technology client — demonstrating in-house hardware R&D capability for bespoke product design and OEM manufacturing.
items.metricLabel: Custom Intel-based router designed and manufactured in-house
